toolway-vpro-film.blurb: A 0.05 mm self-adhering film that protects finished floors from dust, dirt, and traffic during construction. Available in 161 sq ft and 323 sq ft rolls.
toolway-vpro-film.name: Toolway Tooltech V-Pro Surface Protection Film
toolway-vpro-film.why: Lay this down before other trades come through to keep the finished floor scratch and dust free.

toolway-wax-paper.blurb: Rosin/wax paper under nail-down solid hardwood. 750 sq ft roll.
toolway-wax-paper.name: Toolway Wax Paper Underlayment
toolway-wax-paper.why: Roll this out under nail-down solid hardwood to cut down on squeaks and moisture transfer.

toucan-baseboard-bevel-step.blurb: 5/8 inch by 7 1/4 inch by 10ft bevel step baseboard for finishing the wall line after flooring install. Choose 5 1/4 inch or 7 inch height.
toucan-baseboard-bevel-step.name: Toucan Bevel Step Baseboard
toucan-baseboard-bevel-step.why: Pick the height that matches the room's existing trim profile.

toucan-baseboard-colonial.blurb: 1/2 inch by 5.5 inch by 10 ft baseboard in the most common residential profile. Choose 4 inch or 5.5 inch to match your room's scale.
toucan-baseboard-colonial.name: Toucan Colonial Baseboard
toucan-baseboard-colonial.why: Reach for this when you want a classic, safe profile that suits most homes.

toucan-baseboard-flat-stock.blurb: 5/8 inch by 7.25 inch by 10 ft flat profile baseboard for a clean, modern look. Available in 5.25 inch and 7.25 inch heights.
toucan-baseboard-flat-stock.name: Toucan Flat Stock Baseboard
toucan-baseboard-flat-stock.why: Pick this for a simple, contemporary baseboard with no curves or steps.

toucan-baseboard-two-step.blurb: 5/8 inch by 7.25 inch by 10 ft baseboard with a two-step detail for added trim character. Available in 5.25 inch and 7.25 inch heights.
toucan-baseboard-two-step.name: Toucan Two-Step Baseboard
toucan-baseboard-two-step.why: Choose this when the room calls for more detail than a flat profile gives.

toucan-doorstop-1-25.blurb: 1/2 inch by 1.25 inch doorstop moulding for door jambs and stops. Sold in 7 ft and 10 ft lengths.
toucan-doorstop-1-25.name: Toucan Doorstop Moulding
toucan-doorstop-1-25.why: Use this to finish or replace door stops on interior door frames.

underpad_2_5_white.blurb: Budget standard underlay for laminate floors, 200 sq ft per roll. IIC 52 and STC 66 for basic sound control.
underpad_2_5_white.name: Toucan 2.5mm White Foam Underpad
underpad_2_5_white.why: Pick this for a straightforward, cost-conscious laminate install.

underpad_3_black.blurb: Quieter underfoot with a built in moisture barrier, 200 sq ft per roll. Best for condos, upper floors and basements under laminate or vinyl. IIC 72 and STC 73.
underpad_3_black.name: Toucan 3mm Black Acoustic Underpad
underpad_3_black.why: Our pick when sound control and moisture protection both matter.

underpad_5_airflow.blurb: Dimpled air-gap underlay for max moisture protection over concrete or basement subfloors, 100 sq ft per roll. Works under laminate or vinyl. IIC 72 and STC 73.
underpad_5_airflow.name: Toucan 5mm Airflow Bubble Underpad
underpad_5_airflow.why: Use this over concrete or in basements where moisture is a real concern.
